title: Habitats and Living Things
seo_title: Grade 2 Habitats Worksheets: Compare the Living Things in Different Places
standard_text: Make observations of plants and animals to compare the diversity of life in different habitats.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 science worksheets on habitats and biodiversity (NGSS 2-LS4-1): count kinds of plants and animals, compare habitats and read simple data. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Count the kinds of plants and animals to compare habitats.
body_html:
How to think about it

Different places have different living things.

  • A habitat gives food, water and shelter.
  • Count the kinds: fish, duck, frog = 3.
  • Compare places to see which has more kinds.
Example

The pond has 3 fish, 2 ducks and 1 frog. How many kinds of animals?

fish, duck, frog

Answer: 3 kinds

Example

A forest has 9 kinds. A parking lot has 2. Which has more?

9 is more than 2.

Answer: the forest

Common mistakes

  • Counting every animal instead of every kind.
  • Thinking more animals always means more kinds.
  • Thinking any animal can live anywhere.

faq.a: The number of different kinds of living things in a place. A forest has many kinds; a parking lot has few.
Observe each place for the same time, count the kinds of plants and animals, and compare the numbers.
Count kinds. 5 ducks are 1 kind. 1 duck, 1 frog and 1 fish are 3 kinds.
